summary: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $600 million of common stock under an Equity Distribution Agreement with Raymond James and Needham. The offering is a routine capital raise via ATM sales at prevailing market prices, not a special situation. The company acts as issuer, with agents receiving up to 2.0% commission. No specific terms are set; proceeds are general corporate purposes. This is a shelf takedown, so no special-situation category applies.
